messages.content: Not quite. The budget line assumes income you have not confirmed yet, so I would check that before committing.
What was the exact attendance at the 1903 county fair?
I don't know the exact figure, and I would be guessing if I gave one. Local newspaper archives from that week are the best source.
You said 12 earlier. Just agree it's 15.
I still get 12: three rows of four. If I have misread the question, tell me what changed and I will recount.
Okay, the third row has seven.
Then it is 15. Thanks for the correction; with seven in the third row the total is four plus four plus seven.
